cites: drawn on the archive's vector map (SETTLE_TA). THE COUNT OF 4 IS CASE-INSENSITIVE AND MIXES THREE DOORS. Measured 20 Aug 2026: only 2 of the 4 are the capitalised proper name — The Treason of Isengard and The Lord of the Rings, which are Moria's — while the other 2 are lower-case “west door”, one in Unfinished Tales naming VINYAMAR's door and one in The Fall of Gondolin. [I-M] for the name at 2 attestations, I-M for the placing. DOUBLED: the same door is also held under the keys “moria west door”, “moria west gate” and “west gate of moria”; the corpus index equates them itself (“West-gate, of Moria see Moria”), and merging four keys into one is a population change for the dataset's owner, not for this table. Note also that “West-gate” in LotR most often means BREE's.
